set -e
# Ensure plugins directory exists (symlinked from /var/www/html/plugins)
mkdir -p /pelican-data/plugins
# Copy vendor from image to emptyDir (only if empty)
if [ ! -f /mnt/vendor/autoload.php ]; then
  echo "Copying vendor directory..."
  cp -a /var/www/html/vendor/. /mnt/vendor/
fi
# Install composer if not present
if [ ! -f /pelican-data/bin/composer ]; then
  mkdir -p /pelican-data/bin
  wget -q -O /pelican-data/bin/composer https://getcomposer.org/download/latest-stable/composer.phar
  chmod +x /pelican-data/bin/composer
fi
# Install plugin composer dependencies into the shared vendor dir
cd /var/www/html
/pelican-data/bin/composer require socialiteproviders/pocketid:^5.0 --no-interaction --no-progress --no-scripts
/pelican-data/bin/composer dump-autoload --no-scripts --optimize
# Copy composer to shared bin dir for main container
cp /pelican-data/bin/composer /shared-bin/composer
echo "Plugin dependencies ready"

set -e
tailscaled --tun=userspace-networking --statedir=/home/gavin/.tailscale \
  --socks5-server=localhost:1055 >/var/log/tailscaled.log 2>&1 &
until tailscale up --ssh --hostname="${TS_HOSTNAME:-development}" \
  --authkey="${TS_AUTHKEY}" --accept-routes --accept-dns=false; do
  echo "waiting for tailscale up..."; sleep 3
done
exec sleep infinity

apk add --no-cache cifs-utils >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
TARGET=/mnt/e/SCBridge
OPTS="credentials=/etc/smb/creds,uid=1000,gid=1000,file_mode=0664,dir_mode=0775,noserverino,soft,vers=3.0,mfsymlinks,nobrl,noperm,echo_interval=10"
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
# On SIGTERM (pod teardown), stop the loop and unmount, so the
# mount can't be re-laid in the race between preStop and SIGKILL.
# preStop alone left that remount race -> leaked cifs in the
# kubelet ns -> stuck (un-terminating) pods. This closes it.
trap 'echo "[smb-mount] SIGTERM: unmounting and exiting"; umount -l "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null; exit 0' TERM INT
while true; do
  if mountpoint -q "$TARGET" && ! timeout 10 ls "$TARGET" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "[smb-mount] stale mount; unmounting"; umount -l "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  if ! mountpoint -q "$TARGET"; then
    echo "[smb-mount] mounting //10.90.101.86/SC Bridge -> $TARGET"
    mount.cifs "//10.90.101.86/SC Bridge" "$TARGET" -o "$OPTS" \
      && echo "[smb-mount] mounted" || echo "[smb-mount] mount failed (PC off?); will retry"
  fi
  sleep 15
done
